subject: Amendment required to draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.
We have found discrepancies that require your immediate attention and amendment.
For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
For the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Please update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction in all respects.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
